sqlMap.select: SELECT B.TEXT5 AS ACT_UNIT , A.CODE1 AS DEPT , A.CODE2 AS ACCOUNT_TYPE , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMM') AS TERM FROM ICOMCOD3 A, ICOMCOD2 B WHERE A.BUYER = 'KRJOSU0003' AND A.TYPE = 'DTOA' AND B.COMPANY_CODE = A.BUYER AND B.TYPE = 'C001' AND B.TEXT5 IS NOT NULL AND A.CODE1 = B.CODE ORDER BY ACT_UNIT,DEPT,ACCOUNT_TYPE
sqlMap.insert: INSERT INTO EAI.IF_BUYER_BDGT ( KEP_SEQ, BUYER, YYYYMM, DEPT, ACCOUNT, CREATE_DATE, IF_FLAG, RESULT_FLAG, RESULT_MSG, AMT01, AMT02, AMT03 ) VALUES ( EAI.SEQ_IF_BUYER_BDGT.NEXTVAL, 'KRJOSU0003', #IMK_DT#, #IDEPT#, #IACC_CD#, sysdate, 'N', #ORTN_VAL#, #ORTN_MSG#, #OEXE_AMT#, #OCTL_AMT#, #OVIR_AMT# )
sqlMap.select: SELECT BUYER ,PR_NO ,PR_SEQ ,STATUS ,RECV_FLAG ,ADD_DATE ,SUBSTR(ADD_DATE,1,6) AS IBGT_YM ,SUBSTR(PLANT,1,3) AS CCO ,SUBSTR(PLANT,4,6) AS CDIV ,BUYER_ITEM_NO ,DESCRIPTION ,SPECIFICATION ,UNIT_MEASURE ,ITEM_QTY ,UNIT_PRICE ,ITEM_AMT ,ADD_USER_ID ,ADD_LEGACY_USER_ID ,ADD_USER_DEPT ,PLANT ,BUDGET_DEPT ,ACCOUNT_TYPE ,CREATE_DATE ,IF_FLAG ,IF_DATE ,IF_MSG ,RESULT_FLAG ,RESULT_MSG ,AMT01 ,AMT02 ,AMT03 ,IF_AF_FLAG ,IF_AF_DATE FROM EAI.IF_JHTL_PRDT_SEND WHERE IF_FLAG = 'N' AND PR_NO = #PR_NO# AND STATUS = #STATUS# ORDER BY PR_SEQ
SELECT MIN(KEP_SEQ) AS KEP_SEQ ,PR_NO ,STATUS FROM EAI.IF_JHTL_PRDT_SEND WHERE IF_FLAG = 'N' GROUP BY PR_NO, STATUS ORDER BY KEP_SEQ, STATUS
sqlMap.update: UPDATE EAI.IF_JHTL_PRDT_SEND SET IF_FLAG = #IF_FLAG# , IF_MSG = #IF_MSG# , IF_DATE = SYSDATE , RESULT_FLAG = #RESULT_FLAG# , RESULT_MSG = #RESULT_MSG# , AMT01 = #AMT01# , AMT02 = #AMT02# , AMT03 = #AMT03# WHERE PR_NO = #PR_NO# AND PR_SEQ = #PR_SEQ# AND STATUS = #STATUS#

sqlMap.select: SELECT (SELECT TEXT5 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE COMPANY_CODE = PODT.BUYER AND TYPE = 'C001' AND CODE = PODT.CHANGE_USER_DEPT) ACT_UNIT , #ENTRY_DT# AS ENTRY_DT , '3003131' AS VDCODE , PODT.ACCOUNT_TYPE AS ACCNT_CD , '201030100' AS REL_ACCNT_CD , SUBSTR(MAX(PODT.DESCRIPTION),1,13) AS REMARK1 , DECODE(COUNT(*),1,'',COUNT(*)-1) AS REMARK2 , MAX(PODT.DESCRIPTION)||' 외'||DECODE(COUNT(*),1,'',COUNT(*)-1||'건') AS REMARK , SUM(GRDT.ITEM_AMT) AS DEAL_AMT , SUM(TRUNC(GRDT.ITEM_AMT/10)) AS TAX_AMT , 0 AS EXCEPT_AMT , 0 AS EXCEPT_TAX , '2' AS RESOURCES_GB , '09' AS SETTLE_GB , 'N' AS PROOF_YN , 1 AS PROOF_GB , PODT.BUDGET_DEPT AS BGT_DEPT , 'N' AS DEAL_SLIP_YN , 'N' AS TAX_SLIP_YN , 'N' AS TAX_CONF_YN , 'N' AS SB_CRT_YN FROM ICOMGRDT GRDT, ICOMPODT PODT WHERE GRDT.BUYER = 'KRJOSU0003' AND GRDT.STATUS != 'D' AND GRDT.GR_DATE LIKE #GR_DATE#||'%' AND GRDT.BUYER = PODT.BUYER AND GRDT.PO_NO = PODT.PO_NO AND GRDT.PO_SEQ= PODT.PO_SEQ AND PODT.STATUS != 'D' GROUP BY PODT.BUYER,PODT.CHANGE_USER_DEPT,PODT.ACCOUNT_TYPE,SUBSTR(GR_DATE,1,6),PODT.BUDGET_DEPT
